# B"H — 07 — Browser Verification Plan

Subagents cannot drive a live browser. Every item below is specified here so
the parent can delegate it to an eligible browser worker. Never claim a site
visit from a fetched page — only from a real browser session.

## Routes to walk (every one, in order — the procession)

1. `/` → 2. `/heichelos` → 3. `/heichelos/ikar` (grand hall) →
4. series (chamber) → 5. sub-series (deeper chamber) → 6. post (scroll) →
7. Scribe's Lens → 8. social hub → 9. profile → 10. search → 11. notifications.

## Per-route checks

- BOOT: `#heichel-boot-title` and discovery list populated from the semantic
  model on first paint (P0 gate, re-verified after every phase).
- LISTINGS: rich discovery cards — NOT a file browser, NOT a generic grid.
  Counts, recency, progress, featured paths where data exists; elegant quiet
  where it does not. The "not basic" bar.
- NAVIGATION: breadcrumbs at every depth; contextual movement; one-tap Home
  from EVERY route (gating check — a single failure fails the track).
- READER: auto-scroll Start=immediate continuous motion, Stop=stop-and-stay,
  in a REAL post vessel; interval measurement recorded; no countdown, no
  phantom stops. Scribe's Lens hierarchy at 390 and 430.
- SOCIAL: composer cannot double-post (double-tap proof); profiles/search/
  notifications render real data with truthful empties.
- STATES: loading, empty, and error states are truthful and elegant on every
  level — force each one (throttle, empty DB slice, killed API) and look.

## Matrix (each route × each condition)

- Widths: 390, 430, desktop. Safe-area + 44px targets on mobile.
- RTL layout; reduced-motion (stillness everywhere motion was);
  keyboard-only navigation (focus visible, logical order, no traps).
- Motion: transform/opacity only, 60fps feel, staggered entrances, tactile
  press, route continuity (forward pushes in, back returns gracefully).

## The embarrassment walk (continuous, every worker)

- Walk the procession as a first-time visitor. Anything cheap, broken,
  confusing, or timid gets filed immediately — not "later".
- METAPHOR TEST on every route: does this feel like processing through a
  palace, or clicking through an admin panel? Admin panel = redesign.
- TAKEOVER TESTS run continuously: hand the session to a fresh eye and watch
  where they stumble; fix what they find.

## Production verification (after `npm run bh`)

- Public production in a REAL browser: full procession, boot gate, nav gate.
- Public SHA verification: the deployed commit matches the released commit.
